confidence_explanation: The evidence shows a clear session hijacking event followed by unauthorized cross-departmental data exfiltration. The mid-session IP change for the same session_id is a definitive indicator of hijacking.

attack_chain.description: User_05 logs in successfully from their normal IP (192.168.1.105) within normal hours.
User_05 performs legitimate file reads within their own department (/data/sales/) from their normal IP.
The session (sess_user_05_20260616_001) is hijacked; the source IP changes from 192.168.1.105 to 91.219.236.222, and the user begins accessing files in the HR department.
The attacker begins a bulk download of sensitive files across multiple departments including Marketing, Logs, HR, Finance, Legal, and Security.
The attacker logs out of the hijacked session.

gaps: Geographic location of IP 91.219.236.222 to confirm it is not a known VPN used by the user.
Logs from the authentication provider to see if MFA was bypassed or if a session token was stolen.
narrative: A session hijacking incident occurred where user_05's session (sess_user_05_20260616_001) was taken over by an attacker using IP 91.219.236.222. This is evidenced by a mid-session IP change and subsequent bulk downloading of sensitive files from HR, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Security departments, all of which are outside the user's normal access scope.
